subject: Steel Delivery Update — Project Alpha
body:
Dear Sir,

We regret to inform you that the structural steel delivery (Order #ST-2026-0847) for Project Alpha will be delayed by approximately 2 weeks.

Original delivery date: April 5, 2026
Revised delivery date: April 19, 2026

The delay is due to supply chain disruptions at our manufacturing facility in Jamshedpur. We are working to expedite the order and will provide weekly updates.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Best regards,
Ahmed Rahman
Sales Manager, XYZ Steel Corp
trust_reason: Sender matches XYZ Steel Corp's trusted email list
